item.title: Rallying Cry – September 14, 2026
item.description: From Celine Dion’s emotional return to the stage to Iran and Oman agreeing on safer shipping routes, plus residents in Ecuador bravely fighting wildfires and the US women’s basketball team winning another World Cup, today’s news is full of triumphs!
